reviews.text:
No other clinic has treated my little guy so well. A huge thank you to the entire team, especially neurologist Cristian Maeso and veterinarian Pau, who treated us in the emergency room and was so incredibly kind to our baby. Unfortunately, we had to say goodbye to him, but if I ever have another pet, I won't hesitate to come back for treatment.

Thank you so much ❤️

I called on Friday asking for information about an ophthalmologist for my cat. They told me no problem, to bring him in on Saturday. To my surprise, there was no ophthalmologist available. The veterinarian who attended to us didn't even touch Lucas; she only took some photos of his eye to tell us we could have an appointment another day. So we had to pay for what they called a visit, a total of 159 euros, and she didn't even lay a finger on Lucas. I feel cheated and even mistreated. I don't think they are very professional, and I would never recommend this clinic.

Hello Magdalena,
Thank you for leaving such a positive review!
We strive to offer quality service to our clients and patients, and your review encourages us to continue doing so.
AniCura Ars Veterinaria Veterinary Hospital

We want to express our deepest gratitude for the care our big boy, Kai, received. Yesterday afternoon, he underwent surgery for gastric torsion, and we're on our way home right now.
The entire team was wonderful to both us and Kai; they saved his life. They are truly outstanding professionals. Thank you from the bottom of our hearts.
Good hospital, excellent treatment from reception and veterinary team.

Hello AndreaChalco,
We were delighted to see such a positive review, thank you sincerely.
AniCura Ars Veterinaria Veterinary Hospital

We took our dog Olmo to the vet after he had an episode consistent with a herniated disc, and Emili treated us. The experience was truly wonderful.

We loved how she explained what might be happening to him, so clearly and visually, even drawing pictures to help us understand better. We also greatly appreciated how she treated Olmo, who was absolutely terrified. To avoid further stressing him, Emili even examined him outside the clinic, which we thought was incredibly thoughtful.

Furthermore, she advised against a costly test at that time, as she felt it wasn't necessary given the circumstances. For us, this demonstrated her professionalism and showed that her priority was Olmo's well-being, not just running unnecessary tests.

We left feeling very reassured and are so glad we chose to take him there.

The clinic is also beautiful, and all the staff treated us very well. It's not a cheap place, but in our experience, it's well worth it.

We are very grateful for the treatment and, above all, for the trust they instilled in us.
My cat walked in and came out paralyzed, so we had to put him down. I absolutely do not recommend this clinic; I lost my most beloved pet because of them.
One, and because I can't do otherwise. If you want to be without a pet, take it there.

The service was terrible. They took my dog ​​for an hour to do an ultrasound, and when I asked for it, they said they hadn't recorded it. They said they could do blood work to find out what was wrong with her because they didn't know. They made me sign a voluntary discharge form without giving me a diagnosis, telling me what was wrong, or even showing me the ultrasound. All of that cost €250—a complete rip-off and a disaster. I wouldn't recommend them if you love your pets. Always go to your trusted vet because these guys just want to rip you off and don't care much about the animals' health.

Exceptional treatment and care. When you take your dog to an emergency clinic and have to leave him admitted, it generates terrible anxiety. Thanks to the good treatment, attention and professionalism of the Drs. Marta Garcia and Carme Raüll we felt accompanied at all times. And our golden LUKE has been very well treated and cared for. Thank you!

I want to express my enormous gratitude to Dr. Carlota Ramos for the care my dog ​​Molly received today.

After several weeks with a problem we couldn't quite understand, the doctor was extremely attentive, professional, and efficient. She listened with great interest to Molly's progress, examined her with immense care and affection, and quickly identified the problem. She performed the necessary tests quickly and clearly, and we were finally able to pinpoint the cause of her pain and establish a specific treatment plan.

I was especially impressed by her approach: quick and precise, yet at the same time very humane, calm, and caring with the animal. It's clear when a veterinarian not only has knowledge and experience but also truly loves animals.

It's not often you find such professional, clear, and efficient care that is also so personal. For me, it was an excellent experience.

I wholeheartedly recommend Dr. Carlota Ramos and am extremely grateful for the care and attention she gave Molly.

Hello Esther, thank you for your positive review!
Our entire team works to improve the experience for our patients and their caregivers.
Please feel free to share your comments or suggestions with us; we are at your service and wish you a wonderful day.
Best regards!

We were referred from another hospital that didn't have a neurology department at the time, and our veterinarian told us it was one of the best places to take our dog in her condition. The staff was friendly, and although the case ended very badly, the medical treatment seemed adequate, even though in those circumstances you don't usually question things much. However, the subsequent incompetence and difficulty in providing us with all the reports and paperwork has unfortunately made me distrustful.

We were given a same day emergency appointment for our very sick dog and although they couldn't save him, they did all the tests necessary immediately, and did everything to make his stay comfortable.  Claudia was exceptionally attentive and affectionate .
I took Uma there for the first time because of a dermatological problem. I felt confident in her professionalism.

If you value going to UCIAS, you're better off going to another clinic.
The emergency service at this clinic is utterly negligent and shows a complete lack of respect for the patient and their owner. They made us wait an hour with a cat who hadn't urinated all night, even though we had called before arriving, when they told us we would be seen quickly because there were no other patients.

* Misleading pre-call: At 6:50 a.m., I called to ask if I could bring my cat to the emergency room because she couldn't urinate. They confirmed that I should come immediately, that there was no one there, and that they would see her quickly.

* Understaffing and deserted facilities: We arrived at the clinic at 7:05 a.m. The clinic was empty (I have a video recording of the waiting room without a single client). The cleaning staff had to let us in because there was no one at reception, even though we had already been waiting at the door for five minutes.

* * Terrible service and unjustified delays: Once inside the clinic, after 5 minutes, an assistant appeared who didn't even identify himself. He said we would be seen in 10 minutes. Ten minutes later, another woman came by, looked at the cat inside the backpack she was carrying, touched its head without palpating its abdomen to assess it, and simply said that the veterinarians would arrive in another 10 minutes. ALL OF THIS IN THE WAITING ROOM, WHERE WE WERE THE ONLY ONES. It wasn't until 30 minutes had passed (7:35) that the reception staff arrived, took our information, and told us to go into room 1.

* Failure to comply with their own triage protocols: The clinic itself has a sign (photo attached) displaying the maximum waiting times according to the severity of the condition. For difficulty urinating, they set a maximum of 30 minutes. In our case, it was even more serious because he didn't urinate all night... it took them an hour to see us. They didn't see us until 8:10 a.m.

* Lack of on-call veterinarians: We weren't seen by a veterinarian until 8:10 a.m., and that only happened because I went to complain at reception when I saw them starting to prioritize dogs with scheduled appointments over an emergency. The veterinarian who saw us had just started work at 8:00 a.m. (I saw her come in wearing street clothes), which shows that they kept us waiting simply because there wasn't a veterinarian present at 7:05 a.m., despite having told us on the phone to come without delay.

* Arrogance in response to the complaint: When I paid, I expressed my dissatisfaction with the terrible time management to Mireia/Mirian (I don't remember the first name). Far from apologizing or acknowledging their malpractice with an animal that required urgent care, and which they took an hour to see by the veterinarian, when their protocol indicates a maximum of 30 minutes for such cases, they tried to be right at all times and justify the unjustifiable.

Making a cat wait an hour in an empty emergency center (while their wall displays achievements like the Gold Cat Friendly Clinic), lying about veterinarian availability, and prioritizing scheduled appointments is unacceptable. I do not recommend this center under any circumstances.

Edit: I'll add that they performed an ultrasound on my cat and said they would send it to us by email the same day. Late that same day, we asked for it. They said they would send it. The next day, the same thing happened (we asked them by email, so they had the correct email address to reply with the ultrasound), but it still hadn't arrived. The following day, we discovered they had written "hotmial" instead of "hotmail" in the email. Administratively, they are also not recommended, given what we've seen.

This is supposed to be a 24/7 urgency hospital. Well I took my cat there on a bank holiday before a weekend and they kept it there till Monday because there was no ultrasound sound specialist and no one to do the other tests he needed until Monday. So I ended up paying 2000€ just because they had to stall and they also couldn’t give me a diagnosis for 4 days for the same reason. Also, be careful with the bill because they will try to charge you more and then say it was an error in the system only if you notice. It happened twice and the error was of more than 500€. They also sold me a medicine for 43€ to give to my cat for 30 days that was expiring in 2 weeks. My cat has been discharged for 3 days now and I still have to call them everyday for them to send me the exam results via email. Every day they answer saying that they are going to do it immediately but I still haven’t received anything.

I can't say anything but thank you. Three years ago, they saved my dog's life. It was tough; he was hospitalized for 15 days, had many transfusions, and wasn't recovering his platelets. It was a matter of life or death when they removed his spleen, and thankfully, Barbara recovered. Now he has other problems with his tummy, eyes, and mouth. We have an appointment scheduled with Dr. Catala for his mouth, and on the same day, he'll have an ultrasound for his tummy. During our first appointment with the general practitioner, they referred us to an ophthalmologist that same day, and it was perfect. Everything was coordinated quickly and efficiently, trying to fit several appointments and possible surgeries into one day.

The best clinic you can take your pet to.

We brought Tina, my dog, in critical condition after she was hospitalized at another clinic. She was initially admitted for gastroenteritis, and after several days, they insisted she either have surgery or be euthanized. We were terrified, fearing we would lose her. But when we took her to AniCura, after just three days, she was already recovered without needing surgery or any other invasive treatments.

The care was incredibly professional and gave us so much peace of mind. I will never take her to any other clinic. We are so grateful and happy to have our dog back home, happy and healthy, after such a scare.
They take really good care of all my pets. Exquisite treatment, very professional. They are truly excellent, the best.

As always, they were incredibly professional and quick with the diagnosis. It's not cheap, but the professionalism, having all the specialists and the necessary equipment, as well as the hospitalization service, make it worthwhile.

Hi Jordi,
We're so glad your experience with us was positive!

Thank you for taking a few minutes to leave us a review.
AniCura Ars Veterinaria Veterinary Hospital
Thank you very much for your attention. Your professionalism has only been comparable to the care and delicacy provided by veterinarian Carla in the emergency room.
A top-notch veterinary hospital in terms of medical care, information, treatment, and all types of diagnostic tests.
Excellent professionals who inspire a lot of confidence. The way they treated my pet was outstanding.

I have a teacup poodle, and because of her weight, everything is more delicate than usual. I've been to the emergency room several times, and the ICU team there are excellent professionals. I highly recommend them; personally, they're among the best! Thank you for taking care of and saving Nina 🤍 …

Hi Montse,
We're so glad you had another great experience at our center!

We've shared your feedback with the whole team.

Best regards, AniCura Ars Veterinaria Veterinary Hospital.

All my trust. Our furry child became very sick. The veterinarian Tamara saved him, if it hadn't been for her he wouldn't be with us today. Thank you Tamara, you are an excellent professional and a wonderful person. Thanks also to Carles the neurology nurse for the care he also had with Jethro.

Hi Nino,
We were so happy to see such a positive review, thank you so much!
AniCura Ars Veterinaria Veterinary Hospital
Super professional team.

My experience with ARS Veterinaria, after having trusted them for Mia's 11 years of life, has been deeply painful and disappointing.

Mia was admitted with an intestinal perforation and septic peritonitis, an extremely serious condition associated with polymicrobial contamination that, unfortunately, after several surgeries and many days of hospitalization, ultimately cost her her life.

As a result of what happened, I have learned that there is very strict regulation regarding the use of antibiotics in veterinary medicine. My impression, after reviewing Mia's medical history and the explanations I received, is that ARS maintains a view they themselves describe as "ethical" regarding antibiotic use, which, in my opinion, is far too restrictive for such a serious case.

I believe that, even while respecting current regulations, she could have been provided with broader antibiotic coverage. I am particularly concerned that at a certain point, coverage against anaerobic bacteria was discontinued when, given the intestinal perforation with septic peritonitis, there was a very high probability that they were involved, while the infection persisted and Mia continued to deteriorate.

I don't want to go into details here about antibiotics, cultures, or specific medical decisions because it is a complex matter that I am reviewing through the appropriate channels. I am speaking from my own experience and based on facts documented in her medical record.

I do want to issue a warning based solely on my experience: if I had to admit my dog ​​today with an intestinal perforation and a condition like Mia's, I personally would not choose this center. After what happened, I wouldn't have confidence that she would receive the broad antibiotic coverage I would expect in a case like this.

Beyond the medical aspect, there is something that has deeply saddened me on a personal level.

After 12 nights in the hospital, with Mia in critical condition, and after the center itself informed us that they would no longer take any further action for her, I requested her discharge and took her to another veterinary hospital. When Mia left ARS, therefore, they had no idea how her story would end.

Despite this, no one subsequently contacted me to ask how she was doing or how her condition had improved. Not a single call or message.

I also tried for weeks to get answers to a series of questions. I sent numerous emails and made calls, and I didn't receive a response until more than a month later. To my surprise, when they finally replied, they even addressed me using a name that wasn't mine.

Ultimately, Mia passed away. But they couldn't have known because they never inquired about her. After 11 years as a patient at ARS, this complete lack of follow-up made me feel that whatever might have happened to her after she left the center simply didn't matter.

Furthermore, we're talking about a center whose services are very expensive. In an admission of this nature, very significant sums are paid, and precisely for that reason, one expects the highest possible level of care, as well as follow-up and a human touch commensurate with the cost and the reputation of the center.

I've known ARS for many years, and my perception is that it has changed. Before, I felt it was a much more familiar and welcoming hospital. It's now part of AniCura, and after this experience, I can't help but think that by joining a large group, it has lost some of what, for me, made it special.

Mia is no longer with us, and nothing can change that. But after 11 years as a patient, I expected so much more, both in terms of care and the personal attention I received.

They treated Jade with so much love and care, taking their time to get her ready. She received top attention, and the way they made sure she was comfortable before starting, explaining her condition and what was happening, was admirable. Jade felt great with Tamara, the veterinarian who cared for her. Thank you! You should definitely go there to have your furry friends looked after.

Thank you, Tamara, and thank you to your team and the reception staff as well for being so kind.

Hello Lidia, thank you for your positive review!
Our entire team works to improve the experience of our patients and their caregivers.
Please feel free to share your comments or suggestions with us; we are at your service and wish you a wonderful day.
Best regards!

Hi Luis, thank you for your positive review!
Our entire team works to improve the experience for our patients and their caregivers.
Please feel free to share your comments or suggestions with us; we are at your service and wish you a wonderful day.
Best regards!

I can only express my gratitude for how they treated our kitten Neon. The neurologist, Sofía, was incredibly empathetic and an exceptional professional. Sadly, we had to say goodbye to our little baby; it was horrifying for us, but she gave us calm, reassurance, and above all, she thought of Neon. She didn't sugarcoat the situation; she was clear, and that gave us the strength to make the decision to say goodbye.

A million thanks ❤️❤️❤️
Fantastic and cozy place, well located and exquisite and very friendly service

Yesterday I took my dog ​​to the emergency room at ARS Anicura. He was in such bad shape when we arrived that, sadly, nothing could be done but euthanize him. However, the veterinarian who treated us, Laura Castillas, was incredibly professional, empathetic, and caring, both with our dog and with me and my daughter. Such a difficult time was made much more bearable thanks to her clear explanations and excellent care. We are very grateful to her.

Very prepared veterinary center. Good professionals. My cat is in the process of healing with a good prognosis thanks to the speed of action and the work/professionalism of their entire team. They have a good clinical eye and that's all. Although the waiting time in the room is long, I think it's a good center to take our pets and be treated as they deserve.
I recommend it 100x100.
Hello, we took our 16-year-old dog Ada in with a uterine infection, pyometra if I'm not mistaken. Everything was excellent, the treatment and the service.

EXORBITANT PRICE
I've always gone to Anicura Glorias, but due to a move, Anicura ARS was more convenient. I trusted the company, thinking it would be the same.
The service was good. The visit for my two cats, including vaccinations, lasted 20 minutes and cost €170 for both (€85 per cat).
When comparing this to the invoices from Anicura Glorias, the difference is significant (at Anicura Glorias, as of today, each vaccination costs €58, according to a phone inquiry). I called Anicura ARS again to see if they could explain, since they are different centers and set their own prices, which I understand, and the invoice had already been paid. Then, the receptionist asked me the price I had been quoted by Anicura Glorias. Her last question was, "Are you going there now?" The conversation ended abruptly.

I don't mean to imply he's a bad vet, but I do want to point out that the price difference between the two clinics, which are only 6km apart, seems excessive.

I hope this comment helps you avoid the same situation I did. I trusted the "brand" and didn't realize the prices would be so different. Anicura Glorias is fantastic and cheaper; I highly recommend it.
Good treatment and quality veterinary care
I was pleasantly surprised, a specialized service where you can take your "children", careful and very professional, they are not scammers at all, all kinds of tests to cure the furry ones at home.

We went for an emergency visit because our dog had been referred from another 24-hour emergency clinic due to paresis in both hind legs. After the initial assessment, they took Ringo away without letting us accompany him (I understand the procedure given the emergency, but they should at least have allowed us to stay with him and explained to us at all times what they were going to do and why).

Once Ringo was sedated and stabilized, they explained that the problem was with his spine. It could be traumatic and resolve with simple anti-inflammatories, or it could be more serious and require surgery. Only an MRI would give us the answer. Having received a quote for everything, with them arguing that it was the best veterinary center for these cases, we decided to accept.

After an hour's wait, they told us they couldn't perform the MRI due to a lack of technicians, and that we would have to find another clinic that could perform the diagnostic test and subsequent surgery.

Luckily, we had our own vehicle to transport Ringo and didn't have to rely on taxis. After another hour's wait, they handed Ringo back to us with an IV in place to expedite the process at the other clinic (which we had contacted independently due to the poor service we received). They only charged us for the blood work (thank goodness).

It's worth mentioning that the veterinarian who attended to us was extremely kind and apologized for the handling of the situation. We understand that this technical aspect wasn't her responsibility. We blame the organization for this situation, especially in such a serious case as Ringo's, who, thanks to our quick action, was operated on at another center that same night and is now out of danger.

I hope you read the whole story because I find it shameful.

They are the worst. Without my authorization, they performed physically invasive tests on my dog. He was unable to walk for three days. They performed a rectal exam without my consent and without anesthesia. I will never take my dog ​​to this clinic again.

So many compliments!
We are so happy for your loyalty, and the entire team at AniCura Ars Veterinaria Hospital Veterinari thanks you for your trust.

This veterinary center advertises itself as one of the best in Barcelona, ​​but the truth is, their only interest is in getting paid, and nothing else. They excel at that.

In my specific case, I took my dog ​​there, and they gave me expectations of almost a full recovery, which, as you can see, didn't come to pass and won't come to pass in your case either. They'll play with your emotions and your wallet.

If you later demand accountability, no one responds; they accept silence as acceptable, adopting the ostrich tactic, like good veterinarians.

I'm writing this so that everyone files complaints with the Consumer Information Office (OMIC), the Official College of Veterinarians of Barcelona (COVB), and ultimately take legal action, where they will definitely respond. Always seek second opinions from other veterinarians; these are not to be trusted.

I also recommend you get out of this place as fast as you can and go to another one, such as the Bellatera Veterinary Center at the Autonomous University of Barcelona (UAB), or the Montjuic Veterinary Center. Do it for your pets; they will thank you for it.

This review is authentic, not bought like many others you have published.
Good clinic, expensive, no parking and almost everything is for emergencies, patience is key, you have to wait

I took my cat in with an obstruction, and from the very first moment, they treated my Joey wonderfully. He was hospitalized for two days, and I truly have nothing but words of gratitude. It's amazing to see how well and lovingly they care for the animals. I wish there were more clinics like yours; you're fantastic. Thank you for everything 🙏💜

The service was terrible. We came because of our insurance coverage for an emergency, and when we arrived they made us wait ages. In the end, they told us they were completely overwhelmed and extremely busy, and literally there was nobody there. They told us it wasn't urgent, and on top of that, the bill would have been exorbitant if they had seen us, but they just didn't feel like helping us.

Hi Isabel,
Thank you for such a positive review!
It means a lot to us to know you had a good experience at our center.

Thanks again. AniCura Ars Veterinaria Veterinary Hospital
Fantastic service from the whole team

I discovered Anicura Ars a year ago because my dog, Aura, could barely walk and her back legs were giving out. I looked at several veterinary hospitals and finally chose Anicura Ars, and I couldn't be happier.

At the time, Maria, from the trauma department, saw us and took us for a walk around the facilities with Aura so we could see how she was walking. My dog ​​is very afraid of the vet and hardly lets them touch her, but even so, Maria (as well as Meritxell later, whom I'll talk about later) was understanding and receptive, helping Aura with patience and affection. They performed the necessary tests, showed us the results, and gave us medication. Maria also gave us an email address so we could update her on Aura's progress, send her videos, and/or ask her questions. Her responses were also thorough and reassuring.

Today, Aura walks, runs, and jumps without any problems. They've given her back to us. She's gone from just wanting to sleep to wanting to play.

Also, as I mentioned, Aura hardly lets anyone touch her. This time we went to the vet for her annual vaccination, thinking that since they were able to handle her last time, they would be able to this time too. This time Meritxell attended to us, also very reassuring and professional, and they were finally able to give Aura her vaccinations. She didn't mind if I left the room at that moment, since it makes me very nervous to see Aura "having a hard time" because of her fear, but they managed to do it faster than I expected.

Thank you so much, from the bottom of my heart. We will go back there every year to get Aura vaccinated, as they give me peace of mind both because of their kindness and their professionalism. Thank you for your patience, and thank you for bringing Aura back to me a year ago.

my dog koda was tranferred here from Balmes because of lung consolidation and zero platelet.. as a physician l think my dog was suffering from ITP.. we paid €3000 as a deposit and she died after <12hrs with ZERO diagnosis... they should have been more aggresive with mgt. high dose steroids. Ig. Vincristine or at least transfused her with platelet concentrate while waiting for her scan.. they did nothing just oxygen.. even the scan was not done .. maybe they think we cnt afford to pay them because we are Asians..like most domestic helpers. When my daughter went to see my dogs body and asked what was the diagnosis, the vet said most prob lung torsion!!! can you have zero platelet so fast with lung torsion?? lm so frustrated ..nothing. zero management except for oxygen for >€3000.. l dont mind paying >€50,000 if they have managed my dog properly..

Hello Mons, thank you for your positive review!
Our entire team works to improve the experience for our patients and their caregivers.
Please feel free to share your comments or suggestions with us; we are at your service and wish you a wonderful day.
Best regards!
I had to wait 3 hours for my dog's emergency appointment. That would be acceptable if it weren't for the fact that the prices are three times higher than other clinics. Very expensive.

So many compliments!
We are so happy for your loyalty, and the entire team at AniCura Ars Veterinaria Hospital Veterinari thanks you for your trust.

I'm still waiting for tests on my dog, and although it doesn't look good, I want to thank the neurology team, especially Christian Maeso, for the exceptionally good care and management they've given my dog. Kratos is a dog with very complex veterinary needs, and at all times, both he and his partner understood this and respected his pace and limitations.

So, whatever the results of the MRIs next Tuesday, I want to express my gratitude for the care I've received from the moment my vet referred the case, as they even went out of their way to find an appointment earlier.

Hi Gabriel,
We're so glad your experience with us was positive!

Thank you for taking a few minutes to leave us a review.
AniCura Ars Veterinaria Veterinary Hospital
Thank you for your help!

Amazing place 🙌 They saved my dog! Everyone treated him with so much love and professionalism from the moment we arrived at the emergency room until we were discharged. Without a doubt, the best veterinary hospital in Barcelona. Thank you so much for your work 💕 …
Our dog Bruce was admitted to this center a week ago. Many thanks to neurologist Tamara Heredia for her excellent care and clear explanations of the diagnosis. A true professional.

We were delighted with the care provided by our neurologist, Tamara. We were worried and anxious, but her professionalism and kindness reassured us, and Tanque is already receiving treatment :) The nursing and reception staff were also excellent. Thank you so much for your attention.

Death and more death! €3000 without knowing what my dog ​​died of, and without the neurologist, Tamara (I'll spare you the adjective), even showing her face after the first visit where they said nothing was wrong with my dog ​​and that she was going to recover... By the way, I recommend you don't leave without the reports in hand because they take a week to provide them, I suppose so you can't go somewhere else for a second opinion.

A huge thank you to the entire Ars team—vets, assistants, and receptionists alike—for the wonderful care they gave my princess Lola and for their patience with my constant calls. Everyone complains about the high cost, but there's no price too high for the health of our pets. I had to go into debt, but I would do it a thousand times over and return to Ars Clinic without hesitation. Thank you so much for everything, on behalf of Lola and myself. 🥰🥰🥰

Hi Alex, thank you for your positive review!
Our entire team works to improve the experience for our patients and their caregivers.
Please feel free to share your comments or suggestions with us; we are at your service and wish you a wonderful day.
Best regards!
Excellent professionals! I recommend them!

Yesterday we visited doctor oncologist Andrea Pérez, and I wanted to express my heartfelt gratitude.

She spent a great deal of time with us, carefully explaining the entire situation and going through every detail. Our dog has a devastating and terminal diagnosis, and it meant so much to me that she dedicated an hour and a half to us, delivering the most difficult news with such compassion, kindness, and empathy.

After the appointment, I felt a sense of peace and reassurance and I could fully understand all the picture.

I would also like to emphasize what an outstanding professional she is. This is not our first experience with a veterinary oncologist, and her expertise was truly exceptional.

Thank you so much for everything. I highly recommend this specialist.
Excellent professionals and Yara goes to the vet happily because they treat her with great care.

Hi Yarie,
Thank you for leaving such a positive review!
We strive to offer quality service to our clients and patients, and your review encourages us to continue doing so.
AniCura Ars Veterinaria Veterinary Hospital

Today I said goodbye to my Nirvana.

I want to sincerely thank the entire team. To the reception staff, for their kindness, their gentleness, and their incredibly humane treatment during such a difficult time.

And especially to Marta, her specialist. When someone works with so much love, dedication, and passion, it shows. It inspires confidence, calm, and the certainty that Nirvana was in good hands.

Thank you, Marta, for your honesty, for always trying your best, and for treating her with such respect and professionalism.

Although today is a very sad day for me, I find peace in knowing that Nirvana was cared for there as she deserved: with love, dedication, and complete professionalism.
They charged me 248 to make my cat vomit and he didn't vomit 😭😭😭 hahaha …

I had to take my dog ​​in for an emergency. The care from all the staff was exceptional. We felt perfectly informed at all times about the tests they were doing and the possibilities. The vet was fantastic. The next day she called personally to check on her.

A terrible clinic. We're waiting for the ophthalmologist for a long time and, finally, we say that we can't help him because the move was demise. A terrible time and a terrible professional failure. I don't want to go to this clinic.
Terrible clinic. We sat for two hours waiting to see the ophthalmologist, who finally said that the dog was spinning too much and therefore he couldn't help. Never go to this clinic.

We brought our French Bulldog in because he had broken his elbow, and he was treated very well by all the staff. The operation seems to have been a success, so we are grateful to the entire team at Ars Veterinaria for the care he received.
The experience and service at this site has always been very disappointing. We do not recommend it.

Now I finally have the strength to write about my experience and honor my dog, Yerma, who has endured a year and a half of utter suffering due to the negligent treatment at this "veterinary center."

In the early hours of Monday morning, my greyhound started pacing in circles, her eyes darting wildly from side to side. I rushed to the center's emergency room, and when I arrived, they kept me waiting for over 12 minutes before someone would open the door. I was unsure if they were even open (I was about to leave). Once they finally opened the door, a young woman attended to me with a completely passive and unempathetic attitude. After noting the symptoms, we decided to admit her. I want to make it clear that weeks earlier, she had been diagnosed with a heart murmur at another veterinary center and was taking medication for it. After paying 80% of the estimated cost, she was admitted for three days. They do call me every morning to explain Yerma's progress, which I appreciated. On one of the calls, they told me they had anesthetized Yerma to rule out any possible brain tumors, and my reaction was one of astonishment and pure terror, since Yerma was 13 years old and had a history of heart murmurs. You put a 13-year-old dog with a murmur under the anesthesia?! Then you discharge her and tell me she was fine?! DIAGNOSIS: possible geriatric idiopathic vestibular syndrome. Is it necessary to anesthetize her when she's old and you see it's a vestibular syndrome? NO!!! But of course, the bill isn't the same if you diagnose a vestibular syndrome as if you do a thousand more tests. After paying the bill, Yerma was given back to me without any medication, not even preventative medication, which I asked about at reception, completely baffled by the whole thing. I took Yerma home, and during the following nights after her discharge, I noticed that in the silence of the night, her heart was beating with an abnormal force and rhythm. Alarmed, I went to my cardiologist, Nuria, to explain the situation, and she told me to bring Yerma in urgently. The result? Severe atrial fibrillation as a result of the anesthesia. At this point, the treatment was a matter of life or death, with more than 10 pills divided into doses every four hours or less, and diuretics to prevent pulmonary edema, seven days a week. She lost all her muscle mass, becoming a skeleton, and I cried every day from anger and helplessness. This went on for 15 straight months, with ups and downs, with the fear of finding her dead at home, asking to be allowed to leave work in the mornings and afternoons to give her medication, and above all, watching her fight to live, because she certainly had a strong will to live. In the end, Yerma left, and she left feeling loved and cared for until her very last second. She left knowing that these scoundrels didn't care about her, only about lining their own pockets, their sole concern being to issue a hefty bill. Know that I curse you, that I don't speak well of you to anyone, and that you have a complaint filed against you with the veterinary association. You are evil people, and even though there are positive reviews, we all know how you operate. This center is run by an investment group that, by the way, is losing millions, which it tries to cover up by deceiving and playing with the feelings of the owners of these angels on earth. Yerma and I hope you fall and pay for all the evil you do.

Our dog, Rocco, an 11-year-old Golden Retriever, passed away after being taken to this clinic for emergency treatment. It's very difficult to write this, but we feel it's necessary to share our experience.
During Easter week, while we were traveling, he began panting very intensely. We first went to the veterinary hospital in Lleida, where he was diagnosed with partial laryngeal paralysis, a relatively common condition in dogs of his age and breed. Since they couldn't stabilize him with medication, they recommended we transfer him urgently to Barcelona for surgery.
We arrived at ARS around 2:00 a.m. Although Rocco was somewhat calmer, the problem persisted. They informed us that his oxygen saturation was 99% and that they would perform tests and analyses to prepare him for surgery. They gave us a quote, we accepted it, and we left to wait for news.

At 8:00 a.m., we received a call informing us that the initial estimate was incorrect: a different type of surgery had been considered, and the necessary procedure would have cost an additional €1,500. We accepted the new estimate so they could proceed as soon as possible.

Shortly afterward, we received the worst possible call: Rocco had not survived the procedure. After the stent was placed, he suffered a cardiac arrest from which he could not be revived.
We have many difficult questions to answer. If he was admitted as an emergency at 2:00 a.m. and was stable, why wasn't the surgery performed until 8:00 a.m.? Was the procedure delayed until the new estimate was confirmed and payment received? We feel that this delay could have worsened his condition and increased the risk.

We understand that in medicine—including veterinary medicine—there are unforeseen situations and unavoidable outcomes. But it is incredibly painful to have done everything possible to save someone we consider a son, only to be left with the feeling that time worked against him. Furthermore, the surgery was billed in full, despite the outcome, which only adds to the frustration at an already devastating time.
We share this experience with respect, but also with sadness and the urgent need for a review of these types of procedures in emergency situations.
